question: What is the hostname of a shared LavinMQ broker on a Loyal Lemming instance, and does an AMQPS publish and consume on it work (port, TLS, a message counted twice against the monthly quota)? The same AMQPS check applies to a Little Lemur instance.
why: unverified: behind a sign-up. The console shows the connection URL and server name only on the instance details page, and the documented pattern is a name under lmq.cloudamqp.com with the management interface at https://{hostname}.lmq.cloudamqp.com. Creating an instance is the operator's step (rq:operator).
